name: Television
definition: screen sold with television reception or as a television, of any display technology.

name: Rear-projection television
definition: Television whose picture is projected onto the screen from inside its cabinet.

name: Projector
definition: projector that throws a picture from a video or computer signal onto a screen or wall from a distance.

name: Ultra-short-throw projector
definition: Projector made to sit at the wall just below the image it throws.

name: Slide projector
definition: projector that shows photographic slides.

name: Cine film projector
definition: projector that shows motion-picture film.

name: Turntable
definition: record-playing deck with platter and tonearm.

name: CD player
definition: player for compact discs.

name: Blu-ray and DVD player
definition: player (or recorder) for Blu-ray and DVD video discs.

name: Cassette deck
definition: hi-fi component that plays and records compact cassettes.

name: Network streamer
definition: hi-fi source that plays music from the network or streaming services into an audio system.

name: Streaming stick or box
definition: stick or box that plays streamed video and audio on a television (K-150).

name: Set-top box
definition: box that receives broadcast television for a screen (K-150).

name: MP3 player
definition: Portable device sold mainly to play stored or streamed music, with no calling; a Toniebox-type player for children is listed here.

name: FM/DAB tuner
definition: hi-fi separate that receives radio broadcasts for an amplifier, with no speaker of its own.

name: Integrated amplifier
definition: stereo amplifier with preamplifier and power stage in one box.

name: Stereo receiver
definition: stereo amplifier with a built-in radio tuner.

name: Preamplifier
definition: control and switching stage that feeds a separate power amplifier.

name: Power amplifier
definition: amplifier stage that drives speakers from a preamplifier signal, stereo or one channel per box.

name: AV receiver
definition: multichannel amplifier with surround decoding, video switching and a tuner in one box.

name: AV processor
definition: multichannel surround preamplifier and decoder that feeds separate power amplifiers.

name: DAC
definition: external device whose designed function is converting digital audio to analogue.

name: Headphone amplifier
definition: external device whose designed function is amplifying a headphone signal.

name: DAC and headphone amplifier
definition: external device that converts digital audio and drives headphones in one unit.

name: Phono preamplifier
definition: stage that raises and equalises a phono cartridge signal to line level.

name: Bookshelf speakers
definition: compact speaker cabinet made to stand on a stand, shelf or desk, passive or active.

name: Floor-standing speakers
definition: tall speaker cabinet that stands on the floor.

name: Centre speaker
definition: speaker made to carry the centre channel of a surround system, placed at the screen.

name: Surround speakers
definition: speaker made for the side, rear or height channels of a surround system.

name: In-wall and in-ceiling speakers
definition: Speakers without a cabinet, with a mounting flange, built into a wall or ceiling.

name: Subwoofer
definition: speaker that reproduces only bass.

name: Portable and wireless speakers
definition: Self-contained speaker in one box that is neither a bar nor a bass-only speaker; wireless streaming, battery and multi-room are features, not separate types.

name: Soundbar
definition: speaker made as a bar for a TV, with or without a separate subwoofer.

name: Home cinema speaker system
definition: package of speakers for a TV sold and compared as one system.

name: Open-back headphones
definition: headphone whose cups enclose the ear and are open at the back; semi-open files here.

name: Closed-back headphones
definition: headphone whose sealed cups enclose the ear.

name: On-ear headphones
definition: headphone whose pads rest on the ear.

name: Headset
definition: Headphones with an attached microphone, whatever they are used for.

name: In-ear monitors
definition: sealing in-ear earphone with standard tips, sold for listening (K-143).

name: Custom in-ear monitors
definition: In-ear earphones with shells moulded to one listener's ear, sold for listening.

name: Earbuds
definition: earphone that rests in the outer ear without sealing the canal.

name: True wireless earbuds
definition: Two separate wireless buds sold with a charging case.

name: Open-ear earphones
definition: earphones that leave the ear canal open, by bone conduction or an open-ear driver.

name: Compact hi-fi system
definition: music system with source, amplifier and speakers sold as one unit (`size_label`: mini, midi, lifestyle, music centre).

name: Radiogram
definition: furniture-style cabinet combining a radio and a record player with speakers.

name: Boombox
definition: Portable radio-cassette or CD system with built-in speakers and a carry handle.

name: Karaoke machine
definition: machine that plays music for singing along with a microphone input.

name: Jukebox
definition: Machine that plays a selected record or track, however it is paid for, unless it is sold as an arcade or coin-operated game.

name: Radio
definition: broadcast receiver with a built-in speaker (`placement`: table, portable; D-18).

name: Clock radio
definition: radio combined with a clock or alarm.

name: Radio scanner
definition: receiver that scans and listens to radio frequencies (D2 §9.3).

name: Smart speaker
definition: speaker whose designed function is a voice assistant.

name: Smart display
definition: voice-assistant device with a screen.

name: Smart-home hub
definition: device that links and controls smart-home devices.

name: Phono cartridge
definition: pickup cartridge made to fit a turntable tonearm.

name: Turntable stylus
definition: replacement stylus made for a phono cartridge.

name: Tonearm
definition: arm that carries the cartridge across the record, sold separately for a turntable.

name: Headphone ear pads
definition: replacement cushions made for a headphone.

name: Earphone ear tips
definition: replacement tips made for in-ear earphones.

name: Headphone cable
definition: cable made for one headphone model (K-2; standard-connector cables are D1).

name: Projector screen
definition: screen made for a projector to throw its image onto.

name: Remote control
definition: Remote made for one TV or audio system; a universal remote is listed here too.

name: TV antenna
definition: aerial made to receive broadcast television for a TV or receiver.

name: Speaker stand
definition: Stand made to hold one speaker model.

name: TV or speaker mount
definition: Bracket, arm, wall mount or table stand made to hold one TV or speaker.

name: Audio figure
definition: Figure that plays its stored content when placed on its player.

name: Portable cassette player
definition: Battery-powered personal player for compact cassettes, worn or carried and listened to through headphones (Walkman type); a hi-fi deck is D3.2.2.03.

name: Portable CD player
definition: Battery-powered personal player for compact discs, carried and listened to through headphones (Discman type); a hi-fi CD player is D3.2.2.01.

name: MiniDisc deck
definition: Hi-fi component that plays and records MiniDiscs.

name: DAT deck
definition: Hi-fi component that plays and records digital audio tape (DAT) cassettes.

name: Reel-to-reel tape deck
definition: Hi-fi component that plays and records open-reel magnetic tape.

name: 8-track player
definition: Home component that plays (and may record) 8-track tape cartridges; an 8-track player fitted in a car is in Vehicles.

name: Equaliser
definition: Stereo component for shaping the tone or sound field of a signal, such as a graphic or parametric equaliser or a digital sound processor; a surround decoder is an AV processor.

name: Turntable plinth
definition: Base or chassis made to hold one turntable mechanism and its tonearm, sold separately.

name: Bluetooth audio adapter
definition: External unit whose designed function is sending audio from a TV or player to wireless headphones or speakers, or receiving Bluetooth audio for an amplifier.

name: On-wall speakers
definition: Slim speaker cabinets made to hang flat on a wall, often beside a TV; in-wall speakers have no cabinet.

name: Multichannel power amplifier
definition: Power stage with three or more channels that drives home-cinema speakers from an AV processor.

name: Movie server
definition: Box that stores a library of films and plays them on a television or projector (Kaleidescape type).

name: Master clock
definition: External unit whose designed function is supplying a reference clock signal to a DAC, streamer or transport in a hi-fi system.

name: Video processor
definition: External unit that scales and tone-maps video between a source and a TV or projector.

name: Headphone stand
definition: Stand or hanger made to hold headphones when not worn, for one model or any.

name: Earbud charging case
definition: Replacement charging case made for one model of true wireless earbuds.
